tests.title: Main pages show no errors or warnings in the browser console
tests.goal: Normal use of the app logs no errors or warnings in the browser console, for every role.
preconditions: An admin account (logged in session or TWW_ADMIN_USER / TWW_ADMIN_PASS in .env)
A QA editor and a QA viewer (created per test, deleted afterwards)

steps.text: Open the browser console (F12 > Console) and keep it open
As admin open 儀表板, 消息模版, a template (each tab: 聯絡人, 回覆統計, 變數映射), its contacts and edit pages, 用戶管理 and its 添加用户 dialog
Repeat the page visits as the QA editor and the QA viewer

expected.text: No red errors, warnings or failed requests (4xx/5xx) on pages the role is allowed to open
Pages that do not exist may log a 404 for that page only

notes: Playwright sweep of 12 pages + template tabs, new-template dialog, dashboard search and add-user dialog. Admin: only the DialogContent warning on /users (BUG-042); 404s only on deliberately missing pages. Editor and viewer: 404 errors on the admin-created template pages (BUG-038/BUG-039, not this case). No page errors (uncaught exceptions) for any role.
